principles: Customizable young astronaut; no fixed gender.
Cometa optional to player and completion; Scout required by current simulation completion.
Narrative flavor cannot mutate physical truth; choices read simulation outcomes.
Radiation is invisible; no lunar clouds or lightning.
Cometa experiences no harm and does not sniff in vacuum.
History is hypothesis until supported by evidence.

beats.playableAction: Walk to the console; optional Cometa encounter is proposed.

dialogue.speaker: Reyes
dialogue.line: Aurora precisa de gente que saiba observar.

dialogue.speaker: PIP
dialogue.line: Vamos começar por uma leitura?

dialogue.speaker: Reyes
dialogue.line: Cometa pode acompanhar, se você quiser.

beats.playableAction: Diagnose, shed nonessential load and observe recovery.
beats.evidence: Diagnosis and load shed; 15 stable ticks.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: A reserva está caindo. O que você consegue medir?

dialogue.speaker: PIP
dialogue.line: Reduza uma carga e acompanhe a tendência.

dialogue.speaker: Reyes
dialogue.line: Levamos só o que foi preparado. Cada peça conta.

dialogue.speaker: PIP
dialogue.line: Carga segura. Podemos seguir para a transferência.

beats.playableAction: Inspect mission-console and repair power, water and oxygen.
beats.evidence: Connection states, energy and reserve readings.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Há circuitos desconectados. Primeiro, confirme as leituras.

dialogue.speaker: PIP
dialogue.line: Reparar um circuito permite fluxo; não enche a bateria.

beats.playableAction: Choose field tools and review reserves; optionally start crop early.
beats.evidence: Loadout flag, reserves and crop state.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: Ferramentas não substituem a volta planejada.

dialogue.speaker: PIP
dialogue.line: Confira energia, água e oxigênio antes de sair.

beats.playableAction: Read the survey and compare proposed environmental traces.
beats.evidence: Survey context; history is an unverified hypothesis.

dialogue.speaker: PIP
dialogue.line: Essa marca pode indicar um caminho antigo.

dialogue.speaker: Cadete
dialogue.line: Pode ser. Vamos procurar mais evidência.

beats.playableAction: Repair and recruit Scout; collect a finite sample at ice-deposit.
beats.evidence: Scout repair and recruitment flags, part and energy debit, sample transfer.

dialogue.speaker: Scout
dialogue.line: Diagnóstico incompleto. Preciso de ajuda.

dialogue.speaker: PIP
dialogue.line: Verifique a peça e a energia antes de começar.

beats.playableAction: Return through return-gate and shelter through active radiation cycle.
beats.evidence: Forecast, sheltered state and stormSurvived flag.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: A previsão mudou. Cancele a saída e volte.

dialogue.speaker: PIP
dialogue.line: A proteção vem antes da próxima leitura.

beats.playableAction: Deliver sample at mission-console; plant and harvest crop after powered growth.
beats.evidence: Processed ice and crop growth/harvest; food added only at harvest.

dialogue.speaker: Elena
dialogue.line: A planta não responde a uma promessa; precisa de luz e água.

dialogue.speaker: Cadete
dialogue.line: Então vamos acompanhar o que ela recebeu.

beats.playableAction: Review actual simulation report and outstanding criteria.
beats.evidence: Complete phase only when all simulation conditions are met.

dialogue.speaker: Reyes
dialogue.line: Aurora está respondendo porque vocês cuidaram dos detalhes.

dialogue.speaker: PIP
dialogue.line: Ainda há leituras para acompanhar.

dialogue.speaker: Cadete
dialogue.line: Uma luz de cada vez.

options: Diagnose and reduce load: recovery and stability become possible.
Leave load on: battery falls and stability is not achieved.

meaningfulChoices.scope: existing simulation actions; proposed explicit comparison
options: Plant early: powered growth starts while energy and water are consumed.
Wait: defer those costs and also defer harvest.

pacing: 2–3 short lines per beat, optional breathers, critical route; playtime targets unmeasured
